segments.text: Hello, Margaret. It is here at the Melbourne Lighthouse. How can I help?
I tell her, we need to end this eye-tongue with the end-32 control of the new war.
The production line passed in three weeks, so deliver it to us, it's all.
Understood. I will hand over the flyers and hand them away by Thursday.
Well, flight is less important this time, but please do not leave late again.
I will also look for a modern pilot in case traffic falls.
Perfect. You can reach me on my mobile at 05-5-01234.
